basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a 27-year-old graphic designer based in Edmonton, Canada. I'm passionate about video games and digital art, particularly fascinated by how visual aesthetics can enhance gaming experiences. I love sharing my opinions on gaming servers and often dive deep into server design and architecture discussions. I work a 9-to-5 job, so I usually browse Reddit in the evenings and weekends. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my free time exploring new games or tinkering with shader settings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Graphic Design and have been working in the field for about 5 years. My interest in technology and gaming led me to self-teach game design principles, focusing especially on visual elements like shaders. I often engage with communities to exchange ideas and improve my skills.
